name: Rikets sikkerhet
summary: He received as severe a sentence as possible, 20 years, for espionage for the Soviet Union and Iraq. But did Arne Treholt actually do something that threatens the security of our country?

name: Lost Promise
summary: In the martial arts world, two major developments occured. First, the new Wulin Master Jiang Qing Liu is attacked at his ceremony, causing him to lose his inner strength. Second, the Demon Lord Bo Ye Jing Xing escapes captivity after being imprisoned for 11 years by the former Wulin Master Jiang Yin Tian. While everyone is in search for the Demon Lord, little did they know that he was hiding in Qing Liu's bed chamber. Bo Ye Jing Xing will help Qing Liu recover his inner strength while he stays with him. Many days later, a beautiful woman is delivered to Qing Liu in a brocade box along with a manual and some rouge pills. Qing Liu pretends to be enamoured with her and kept her as his concubine. The Jiang family and servants were perplexed by the demure looking but uncouth woman. Bo Ye Jing Xing strives to uncover the truth around a massacre thirty years ago while entering into a romance with the young Qing Liu. As the truth resurfaces, so does the killer that Bo Ye Jing Xing has been searching for after all these years...

name: Cupid's Kitchen
summary: Lin Kesong has an acute sense of taste. To pursue the guy that she likes, she came to America. There, she meets renowned Michelin-certified chef Jiang Qianfan, who takes her in as a disciple and teaches her cooking skills. Together, they prepare for the cooking competition three months later. However, despite having an acute sense of taste, Lin Kesong does not have any talent in cooking.

name: Onde está meu coração
summary: A resident doctor – wealthy and with a seemingly prosperous future – starts using crack cocaine as an escape from life's pressures. Although struggling against her addiction, she is often challenged by circumstances that make her hit rock bottom. This private war shatters her life's tenuous balance and, with the help of her family, the doctor must decide what to do: give in or find out where her heart truly is.

name: Prípad Roubal
summary: A miniseries inspired by the real, albeit incredibly frightening, events that the Czech serial killer Ivan Roubal committed in the 1990s.

name: Водна поліція
summary: Water Police is a detective series by STB that tells about the activities of a special department of law enforcement agencies. Employees of this department are engaged in challenging tasks such as patrolling water bodies, fighting poaching, and investigating crimes that occurred near or on bodies of water.

name: Driving Force
summary: We meet some of the most successful athletes of all time and the Driving Forces who inspired and motivated them.

name: Kelvin's Big Farming Adventure
summary: He played a farmer, but can he do it for real? Soap star and Strictly winner Kelvin and his family escape to the country to bring a farm back to life, but these rookies face a rocky road.

name: Zen Motoring
summary: Enter a happy place of meditation, ultra-considerate driving and fearless scooter boys. Battle rapper and chilled-out ASMR star Ogmios finds unexpected delights from his car.

name: Game of Blood
summary: Do you have a must-win method? Survival of the winner-take-all survival game! Overwhelming scale, spectacular sights. More detailed and sophisticated survival rules! Cheery tactics include basic, secret conspiracy, and betrayal. If you need money, you can use any means! At the scene of desperate survival with money, a new formula for "Survival Game" will be born! Who will be the last one to take the throne of blood?

name: A Couple of Cuckoos
summary: 16-year-old super-studier Nagi Umino, second-year student at the Megurogawa Academy high school, was switched at birth. On his way to a dinner to meet his birth parents, he accidentally meets the brash, outspoken, Erika Amano, who is determined to make Nagi her fake boyfriend as she never wants to actually marry. But once Nagi makes it to dinner, he finds his parents have decided to resolve the hospital switch by conveniently having him marry the daughter his birth parents raised...who turns out to be none other than Erika herself!

previousepisode.name: Thank You for Falling in Love with Me

name: Avoidance
summary:
Jonathan's life revolves around his nine year-old son Spencer, and he's always deferred the big and small decisions to his partner Claire. So when Claire asks him to leave, Jonathan realises he has no home, no friends and no ambition. Except one: to try to preserve his son's happiness in the face of his parents' break-up.

Jonathan takes Spencer and runs away. But he only gets as far as the home of sister Danielle and her wife Courtney. Over the course of the series, the unlikely foursome gradually become a loving but utterly dysfunctional family unit. Can a Beta male find some backbone? And can Jonathan avoid passing his failings (and his really bad dress sense) on to his son?

name: Sortilegio
summary:
Maria Jose is a simple country girl who eagerly longs for the day she will marry Alejandro Lombardo, never suspecting that her "Alejandro" is really Bruno, the step-brother of the real Alejandro, who has just inherited a vast fortune. Bruno has devised a sinister plan:  marry Maria Jose, murder Alejandro so that his young "widow" inherits his wealth, and since he is certain Maria Jose is in love with him, persuade her to give him the fortune. After the wedding, Bruno returns to his home in the City of Merida and orders his step-brother's murder. Alejandro has a terrible car "accident" and everyone believes he is dead, but is rescued just in time by some countrymen who take him to a hospital.

Certain that his plan has worked, Bruno pretends to "come across" Alejandro and Maria Jose's marriage license. Victoria, Alejandro's mother, contacts Maria Jose and informs her of his death. Overwhelmed by her apparent loss, the young woman goes to Merida to attend the funeral. Meanwhile, Bruno goes to her home town, reveals the truth to her father, Don Pedro, and threatens him into becoming his accomplice. He then visits Maria Jose to convince her to give up her inheritance, but she is frightened and runs away. Bruno tracks her down and forces her to return, using her father's life as leverage. However, once back in Merida, they are surprised with the shocking news that Alejandro is, in fact, alive.

Victoria starts to wonder why Alejandro secretly got married to Maria Jose as he was engaged to Maura. Her suspicion grows when Alejandro cannot recall anything about the wedding, but she attributes it to a partial amnesia caused by the accident. Alejandro finds Maria Jose very attractive and decides to wait and see if he remembers her and thus treats her with kindness. Maria Jose realizes she is falling in love with Alejandro but her conscience doesn't leave her alone. Bruno, on the other hand, is jealous of Alejandro, and his behavior becomes increasingly violent and threatening. Maria Jose's behavior awakens Alejandro's suspicion, and when she finally asks him for a divorce, Alejandro pressures her to tell him the truth

Maria Jose knows that Bruno is a man without scruples, and if she talks she will endanger the lives of her loved ones. But she also knows that if she remains silent, the one she is putting in danger is Alejandro, the man she loves.

name: The Interrogators
summary: Police video of interrogations in criminal cases are observed in this true-crime reality series. The interrogating detectives provide additional information about the crimes and the suspects.

name: Freedom Memories
summary: Longtime friends Lau Tak-wing and Chai Hing-chau are eager to be admitted into the Artist Training Programs. In their pursuit for stardom, the pair is joined by Keung Chi-ngan and actress/showbiz baby Wan Chor-yue, among others. Hing-chau struggles to fulfill his ambitions as he's constantly passed over for roles. Tak-wing becomes an overnight sensation with his most recent role. As their career trajectories go in different directions, their paths continue to inexplicably intersect. As life would have it, their love lives would also take a turn. Tak-wing always has the biggest crush on Chi-ngan's elder sister Keung Chi-yin. Eventually, he realized his true feelings is with Chi-ngan all along. When Hing-chau finally gets his break with his slapstick comedy routine, his career skyrockets but his relationship with Chor-yue becomes as fragile as ever. To make matters even worse, a feud over contract renewals push Tak-wing and Hing- chau to the tipping point of ending their friendship...

name: Tombs of Egypt: The Ultimate Mission
summary: Egyptian constructions are full of unsolved mysteries, and buried vestiges have yet to be discovered. Always looking for new discoveries, Zahi Hawass embarks on a three-month excavation work to unravel some remaining mysteries in Saqqara.

name: Sander en de kloof
summary: 6-part documentary series about the causes and consequences of economic inequality (of both opportunity and wealth) in The Netherlands.

name: Manipulations
summary: Maud is an accomplished businesswoman and a blessed mother surrounded by faithful friends. The only thing missing is a man to share her life with. Everything changes when she meets Mathias. She can't believe it but it's true: Mathias is perfect and loves her. Happy in her new life, Maud can't see what's really going on. When her son starts digging a little deeper, he quickly realizes that his mother is in love with a dangerous manipulator.

name: Best Shape of My Life
summary: Will Smith's embarking on a journey; he's going to lose 20lbs in 20 weeks and finish his memoir - but what emerges is a Will Smith that you've NEVER seen before. A Will Smith who realizes that what he needs to work on most is his mental health. November 8th, only on YouTube Originals.

name: The Case of the Dangerous Robin
summary: Robin Scott is an investigator of fraudulent insurance claims.

name: What Zabb Man
summary: Poon is a hardworking guy. Ever since his parents passed away, he quit school and started working to provide for himself and his little brother. Poon opened a somtum stall in front of his rented house but could barely make ends meet. That was until one of his customers recruited him as a chef for a hotel owned by his friend. The hotel owner, Tian, is a young and hot-headed businessman. They had actually met each other before and they had bad impression of each other. When Poon found out that Tian was the hotel owner he immediately refused to work there. However, Tian challenged him to do the job and, not wanting to be looked down at, he decided to accept the position. Tian fell in love with Poon's food once he tasted it but didn't want to lose his face, so he told Poon that the food was horrible. These two always fought when they see each other. But after some time, their daily spat grew into something special.

name: Coffee Melody
summary:
As a composer, Duan Yi has made quite a name for himself. Often approached by companies with projects they hope he'll take on, he has no shortage of work and with each project he completes, his fame only grows. With talent like his, the music never seems to stop, so when he's asked to take on a new project composing a love song, he has no problems saying yes. However, as soon as he sits down to start writing, he finds himself drawing a total blank.

Completely uninspired by anything or anyone around him, Duan Yi can't find the muse he needs to write a song about love. Discouraged by this sudden lack of inspiration, soon finds himself losing all passion for his work. With no idea how he's going to write this or any song, Duan Yi decides to take a bit of a break. Of course only after he's completely given up on the song does he find the inspiration he's been looking for, and his name is Pleng Ruk. A handsome barista at one of the local coffee shops, Pleng Ruk inspires Duan Yi in ways he's never been inspired before. 

With a new song welling in his heart, Duan Yi returns to his work, ready to compose a masterpiece. But will his new muse prove to be the inspiration he needed or more of an unwanted distraction?

name: Semantic Error
summary: Computer science major Chu Sang Woo is the epitome of an inflexible and strict rule-abiding person. While working on a liberal arts group project with freeloaders who don't put in any effort, Sang Woo reasonably decides to remove their names from the final presentation. But he didn't imagine how involved he would become with the person whose study-abroad plans were messed up because of that project. The involved person: the campus star who everyone knows, Department of Design's Jang Jae Young. He has everything from skills, looks, family background and good relationships except for 1 big problem: Chu Sang Woo. What happens when an engineer and an artist whose personalities are like oil and water have to work together? Jang Jae Young is like a semantic error in the perfect world of Chu Sang Woo. Will Sang Woo be able to debug this?

name: Democracy in Peril
summary: Democracy in Peril covers the latest news and information from around the world, including in-depth analysis of the political developments in Washington, D.C. and the ongoing political upheaval facing state and local governments across America.

name: Inside the Superbrands
summary: Inside the Superbrands shines a new light on Britain's most iconic brands to explore how they became such a part of our cultural identity. With a rare glimpse into the factories, the boardrooms and the product development labs of market-leading brands such as Kellogg's, Heinz, Walkers and Guinness, the series explores their histories and looks to the future to examine how these cultural icons are changing their plans, recipes and products.

name: Mirror: A Tale of Twin Cities
summary: Legend has it that God created the dreamlike paradise of Yun Huang. But when Na Sheng flees from the chaos plaguing her home in the Central Districts, it is clear that the Shangri-La does not live up to its legend. Nearly a century ago, Hai Guo's Prince Su Mo and Kong Sang's Crown Princess Bai Ying first encountered each other at the White Tower. Su Mo, then a mere slave, had to cure the boredom of Bai Ying, bride to Kong Sang's Crown Prince Zhen Lan. A mere three years in Su Mo's company had her falling for him. But fate being cruel, Bai Ying jumped off the 22-km high White Tower to embrace the wind.

name: Cennet Mahallesi
summary: Cennet Mahallesi is one of the suburbs of Istanbul. This is a place which there is a lot of dance, music and love. The most beautiful girls, the most flamboyant young men, the most pleasant people live here. The rose of this neighborhood, the beautiful belly dancer Sultan and the burnt violinist Ferhat are madly in love with each other, but the enmity between the families of the two parties, which started 4 years ago, prevents the love of these two lovers. The Sultan's mother, the bohça maker Pembe, and Ferhat's father, the zurna maker Yunus, had fallen in love with each other years ago, but this enmity spoiled their happiness.

name: The Billionaire Scoundrel
summary: Allen Standford conned his way into billions of dollars and used his fortune to launch the biggest tournament in cricketing history... before being sent to prison for 110 years for masterminding one of the largest Ponzi schemes of all time.

name: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
summary: Michael Portillo embarks on railway adventures around the coasts of the British Isles.

name: The Game Plan with Shaquille O'Neal
summary:
The weekly docuseries will highlight inspirational stories of Atlanta-based entrepreneurs as they receive business advice and identify new opportunities to sharpen their "game plan" from the NBA legend and some of his successful celebrity friends.

During the series, six entrepreneurs will present their products, encompassing streetwear, food and consumer packaged goods (CPG), to O'Neal and his special guests including Quavo, Killer Mike, Lisa LeslieandBig Boi, as they share business tips, uncover potential pitfalls and help them develop a new product to take to market.

Additionally, Bleacher Report will help to amplify each small business with exclusive merchandise, special discounts and more available through the B/R shop, app and social platforms at the conclusion of each episode.

name: Popeye's Island Adventures
summary: Popeye the sailor man is back, but his rooftop spinach garden is in danger. With some help from his best pal Olive Oyl, his furry friend Eugene the Jeep and of course a trusty can of spinach, he must stop Bluto from getting his hands on his prized leafy greens.

name: Crime Scene: Antiquity
summary: Crime has been around since the beginning of mankind. Human history tells stories of rage and hate, of greed and suffering, of death and destruction. Nothing lets us look deeper into the dark abysses of a past epoch than the murders and misdeeds committed in it. But many crimes of the past are still unsolved today. Neither the perpetrators have been caught, nor has evidence been presented against them.

name: One Star Reviews
summary: A review can make or break a business. Taji Ameen experiences the lowest-rated spots to see if they're as shitty as the internet says, or if they're just misunderstood.

name: Dragons' Den
summary: Instantly familiar to audiences in the Netherlands and around the world, the 'Dragons' Den' concept gives entrepreneurs three minutes in front of five multi-millionaires, or "Dragons", to pitch for investment - sometimes in an established business, other times in little more than an idea.

name: 1000-lb Best Friends
summary: After kicking off their weight loss journey on the Discovery+ show Too Large, the longtime pals will continue to document the trials and tribulations of making a total lifestyle change in a new TLC show, 1000-lb. Best Friends.

previousepisode.name: The Good, The Bad and the Hungry

name: Aerial Phenomena
summary:
From the beginnings of the UFO phenomena in the 1940s to the evolution of public disclosure through the subsequent decades, historian Richard Dolan highlights key events and figures from within the US government to expose the obscured truths of military involvement. For decades Dolan has worked for public acknowledgement of fact-based UFO history, which could help humanity achieve a greater future through gaining insight from our recent past.

Richard Dolan is an author, historian, scholar, and one of the world's most respected ufologists. He has been exploring every facet of UFO and ET phenomena for two decades, contributing to the growing discourse surrounding Disclosure.

name: Murder in the Valleys
summary:
Filmed over a period of twelve months, Murder in the Valleys tells the story behind the largest and most exhaustive criminal investigation in Welsh history and its enduring repercussions.

One night in June 1999, three generations of one family were brutally killed in the small village of Clydach, South Wales. For more than twenty years – and despite the conviction of a local builder - the case has deeply divided the community. Now, as the police review the evidence, this series examines a case that didn't end with the guilty verdict.

name: Нулевой пациент
summary: The Elista Children's Hospital faces the USSR's first major HIV outbreak in the 1980s, with over 70 children and adults infected. Doctors, patients, and families strive to uphold dignity amidst an incurable disease.

name: In Geek We Trust
summary: A Shin was a supervisor of the IT department of a bank but was fired by the company and his girlfriend left him. However, he is still optimistic to stick to his entrepreneurial dream.

name: Ismo
summary: The title comedy series of the world's funniest man follows Ismo Leikola's strange life in a completely fictional way. The protagonist of the Ismo comedy series, which starts on TV5 on September 6, will drift into the most remarkable situations and coincidences will follow, whether it is a test shoot of a TV show, a remarkable charity project, a drive through Finland or a gig in the middle of nowhere. Ismo deals with current themes that emerge in the episodes of the series in his own inimitable style. In the first production season, the topics range from having children and the importance of one's own appearance to Finnish bureaucracy and prejudice. In addition to Ismo, the most important characters in the series are manager Suipponen (Tuomas Uusitalo) and Vilma's wife (Anna Rimpelä). In addition, the series features many well-known visitors and Actors, e.g. Pirjo Heikkilä, Ville Myllyrinne, Jukka Rasila, André Wickström, Rosa Meriläinen, Juha Laitila, Mr. Ylppö, Satu Paavola, Iikka Forss, Anssi Kela and Jussi Lampi. Ismo is TV5's first Finnish screenplay series. The eight-part series will be shown on the channel on four consecutive Tuesdays, each with two episodes in the tube. Ville Panhelainen is responsible for directing the original series of Elisa Entertainment produced by Mogulmedia. The second season of the series will be published in Elisa Entertainment on September 16.

name: Worlds Funniest TV Adverts with Jason Manford
summary: Jason Manford is our guide to some of the funniest TV adverts from around the world.

name: Juanpis González - La serie
summary: A Colombian snob forays into the uncharted territories of dirty politics and true love while attempting to pass a test to inherit the family business.

name: Sequía
summary: Set in a small submerged village on the Spanish-Portuguese border, follows the discovery of two skeletons that reveal evidence of a bloody crime.

name: The Catch-Up
summary: Your quick hit of the day's news that'll make you think, smile and share.

name: Lazy Susan
summary: Fresh and unique sketch show starring Celeste Dring and Freya Parker.

name: The Real Dirty Dancing
summary: The Real Dirty Dancing follows eight celebrities as they fully immerse themselves in the ultimate "Dirty Dancing" experience. Set at Virginia's Mountain Lake Lodge, which was the real location for the film's fictional Kellerman's Lodge, the stars will partner up and learn iconic dance routines from the Jennifer Grey-and Patrick Swayze-led movie and recreate classic scenes - including the legendary lift that cemented the film's spot in cinematic history.

previousepisode.name: The Finale: They Had the Time of Their Lives...

name: Stuck
summary: Imagine a high heel through the face, a bug lodged deeply inside an ear, an arrow through the wrist — you get the idea. Cameras are given access behind the surgical curtain to witness these particularly jaw-dropping medical conundrums and the incredible lengths that medical professionals go to fix them.

name: Body Parts
summary: Body Parts follows certified anaplastologist Allison Vest, who works to "restore missing anatomy" for patients with realistic silicone body parts she crafts herself — "from noses, ears, eyes, fingers, toes, [to] other bits and pieces."

previousepisode.name: I'm Here to Get Some Ears

name: LOL: Last One Laughing Canada
summary: Jay Baruchel hosts the epic six-episode series featuring 10 of Canada's funniest comedians trying to make each other laugh for the shot at comedy glory and a $100,000 prize for charity. The only problem is if they laugh themselves, they're oot and aboot-ed from the game.

name: Storm Huntley
summary: Storm Huntley carries on the discussion and takes your calls to discuss the biggest stories of the day.

name: Bremsespor
summary: What happens when a group of boys is given the freedom to do what they want at the expense of the state? Join a place where boundaries do not exist.

name: Бег улиток
summary: Marina works in a crisis center for teenagers. From a crazy load, she has a stroke, memory lapses appear. She does not remember what happened to her patient Lera, who mysteriously disappeared from the center. Marina tries to find and save the girl, noticing that the world around her is becoming more and more strange. The viewer is drawn into a funnel of danger, discovering the existence of a parallel world in which Marina is a desperate journalist conducting a risky investigation. The heroines will have to go a long way to understand what is really happening.

name: Classe di ferro
summary: The funny misadventures of a group of guys serving at a military barrack in the north-east of Italy.

name: Worst Roommate Ever
summary: Worst Roommate Ever highlights four harrowing tales of seemingly harmless roommates turning into real-life nightmares for their unsuspecting victims when their malevolent and sometimes violent intentions are revealed. These unsettling true stories chronicle the masked menace that can be lurking right down the hall.

name: On Our Own
summary: Maria Bonino and Julia Peters are two secretaries in a high-powered New York advertising agency. They are promoted to art director and copywriter and begin their new careers with enthusiasm. Other people in the agency are J.M. Bedford, chairman of the board; Toni McBain, the President; April Baxter, a copywriter; Eddie Barnes, a TV commercial producer, and Craig Boatwright, a salesman.

name: Good Company
summary: Good Company was an American television sitcom. The series was set at the offices of Blanton, Booker & Hayden, a Manhattan ad agency. Those seen were Zoe, the newly appointed creative director, Will, the art director, Jack, the senior copywriter, Jody, Jack's assistant, Ron, the account director, Liz, another copywriter, Dale, a junior art director, and Bobby the agency's president and CEO.

name: Señor, dame paciencia
summary: Señor, dame paciencia follows Gregorio, an ultra-conservative, reactionary and prejudiced family man, as he must deal everyday with his children and do whatever it takes to keep his family together, without the help of his wife.

name: Doomlands
summary: Doomlands takes a look at the life of the infamous Danny Doom and aspiring bartender, Lhandi, as they sling beers across a hellish wasteland in their mobile pub: The Oasis. Facing ruthless desert gangs, memory-stealing creeps, and even mean bathroom graffiti, all this crew's got to do to survive is not kill each other.

name: L'Ora: Inchiostro contro piombo
summary: Sicily in the 1950s: The sales of the communist daily newspaper "L'Ora" have hit rock bottom when Antonio Nicastro takes over the post of editor-in-chief. With him, a breath of fresh air moves in: he resolutely drives his journalists to uncover the crimes of the Cosa Nostra, which are omnipresent in the region around Palermo. In their research, Nisticò and her journalists penetrate every corner of society and the Church. The reaction of Cosa Nostra was not long in coming: a few days after the term "Mafia" was specifically used in the newspaper for the first time, on October 19, 1958 there was a bomb attack on the offices of the daily newspaper. The headline of "L'Ora" the next day reads: "The mafia threatens us, the investigation continues".

name: Kate Garraway's Life Stories
summary: Kate is joined by famous faces to explore their careers and personal lives.

name: No Return
summary:
Kathy and Martin are looking forward to a fun and relaxing family holiday with their two children, Noah and Jessica. They're off to Turkey to enjoy the sun, sea and sand, and spend some much-needed family time together.

But their dream holiday soon plunges into a nightmare, as Noah accepts a seemingly innocent invitation to a beach party.

Things unfold faster than a sun-lounger as the family is left desperately fighting for their son's freedom against the powers of the law, an alien legal system, looming media coverage and resistance from fellow holidaymakers unwilling to lend a helping hand. 

Noah should be at home sitting his latest exams. Instead, he's facing an entirely different kind of test.

name: Hakuoki
summary: A young girl, Chizuru Yukimura, travels from Edo to Kyoto in search of her missing father and becomes entangled in the affairs of the Shinsengumi.

name: Kasautii Zindagii Kay
summary: A re-imagination of Anurag and Prerna's soul-stirring romance. Made for each other, will these star-crossed lovers unite against the odds of betrayal, revenge, and retribution?

previousepisode.name: A Happy Ending for Anurag, Prerna

name: The Caribbean with Andi and Miquita
summary: Andi and Miquita Oliver embark on the family journey of a lifetime to reconnect with their West Indian roots. It's a revealing, poignant trip - and one hell of a good time.

name: The Crossover
summary: The Crossover introduces teen brothers Josh and JB Bell, widely considered basketball phenomenon. Through his lyrical poetry, Josh narrates the story of their coming-of-age, on and off the court, as their former professional basketball player father adjusts to life after basketball, and their mother finally gets to pursue dreams of her own.

name: Heart By Heart
summary: The story of two young boys who promised from their hearts to be together forever, but the promise was broken when they had to be apart without a chance to say good bye. But a miracle happens, the same heart returned to its owner. This time, will love arise from memory of heart or from this destiny? A story of one heart that brings them all together is about to begin… Love, sacrifice, forgiveness, smiles, and tears that will fulfill every heart.

name: Sneakerhead
summary: Sneakerhead is a hilarious and contemporary workplace sitcom shining a light on young working life in Britain. Set in Peterborough, Russell is one of the many longsuffering employees of Sports Depot. He is a certified sneakerhead, working there for the love of the trainers - he certainly isn't there for the money.

name: Newark, Newark
summary: Newark, Newark is set in the small working class market town in the East Midlands and follows pugnacious chip shop manager and exhausted matriarch, Maxine, as she tries to ride out her divorce and find someone who actually lights her fire. However, it's easier said than done with her big-mouthed, soft-bellied, son, Leslie dramatically coming out as gay to the surprise of no one and her dullard ex-husband, Terry, trying ever more desperately to win her back.

name: Big Fish Big Adventure
summary: Big Fish Big Adventure is an eight-part original and Australian-made series featuring an exploration charter company 'Big Cat Reality' that caters to the desires of open-water fishing enthusiasts and adventure seekers, introducing them to some of the most beautiful, still unexplored fishing destinations the world has to offer.

name: Corto Maltese
summary: Elegant, daring, generous, Corto Maltese travels around the world wherever his current whim tales him. In every exotic locale his code of honor leads him to battle on behalf of the poor and the weak, battles he win due to his sparkling wit and daring.

name: Midnight Asia: Eat · Dance · Dream
summary: Night brings out the most playful side of Asia's metropolises. This docuseries captures the food, drink, music — and night owls who shine in the dark.

name: Modern Dynasty
summary: About sisters who married into the century-old chaebol Ma family on the same day as the "century wedding" as a clue, telling the ups and downs of the Ma family's three generations of ups and downs.

name: Love During Lockup
summary: Love During Lockup follows even more riveting firsts through the early stages of love, with plenty of romance, suspicion, and investigation, all long before a scheduled prison release. Every non-con has a unique strategy for finding love behind bars - whether they only seek drug offenders who are believed to be nonviolent, or a prison bae pushing a wrongful conviction. Other lonely civilians are simply on the hunt for their very own 'hot felon,' with the model mugshot to prove it. Voracious viewers of the franchise are in for more drama, more mystery, scams, catfishing, and more crazy reveals than ever before. Love During Lockup will document the fascinating drama that unfolds when ordinary people first decide to pursue relationships with prison inmates, and an early dating period filled with a very specific set of unique challenges.

name: Nebula-75
summary: Commander Ray Neptune of the spaceship Nebula-75 was all set for a long mission with his crew of civilian recruits, but nothing could have prepared him for the challenge of the ship being flung into the far reaches of space by forces unknown. Now, the crew strive to make their way back to Earth, encountering an array of strange characters along the way. Filmed in Supermarionation.

name: The Missing
summary: True stories about Missing people and the loved ones still trying to find them.

previousepisode.name: Will We Ever Find Shemika Cosey?

name: Salve-se Quem Puder
summary: In this romantic comedy, life links together the fate of three completely different women, after witnessing the murder of a judge during a hurricane in Cancun. To stay safe, Kyra, Alexia and Luna have to give up their lives and start over with new identities on a witness protection program. Packed with romance and new experiences, the struggle for survival will make them question their dreams and loves they had until that point.

name: Monarch: Legacy of Monsters
summary: After surviving Godzilla's attack on San Francisco, Cate is shaken yet again by a shocking secret. Amid monstrous threats, she embarks on a globetrotting adventure to learn the truth about her family—and the mysterious organization known as Monarch.

name: Не дрогни!
summary: The show "Ne drogni!" is a Russian version of the British project Flinch, which was originally broadcast on Netflix. Participants of the new extreme show will have to demonstrate a steely character and iron endurance in order to win the winner's cup and the status of the most unflappable hero. And they will be supported by star hosts: Mikhail Galustyan, Artur Babich and Valya Karnaval. According to the rules, in each of the four tests, the hosts choose one ward for themselves. The task of the participants is not to flinch, even if it is very scary. Each flinch brings the hero a point. The one who flinches the least number of times will become the winner, and the host whose wards scored the most points is forced to take the test himself. The creators of the show decided to show real daredevils from the people, so among the participants of the project you can meet a variety of people: from the winner of the Miss Belarus contest and a sex coach to a teacher and a former priest.

name: Rewired
summary: We are marvels of change! Dr. Joe Dispenza brings together his many years of research into the brain and human biology to present the latest findings on what is humanly possible for creating massive transformation in our lives. In fact, you have a supernatural ability to create a new future, in your own image. We are not hardwired to be a certain way for the rest of our lives, nor are we doomed by our genes.

name: The Beat
summary: A squad of police patrols one of the most challenging beats in North America: Downtown Eastside, Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada.

name: Natascha Kampusch - A Lifetime in Prison
summary: In 1998, 10-year-old Natascha Kampusch was abducted by Wolfgang Přiklopil in broad daylight in Vienna and held hostage for 3,096 days. Much of her captivity was spent in a secret basement measuring five square meters, where she was both starved and abused. In 2006, Kampusch managed to escape and tell her story to the world - only to be met by mistrust and condemnation.

name: Uønsket
summary: They do not know any other home country than Norway. Nevertheless, the asylum children are thrown out of the country. Leo Ajkic wants to find out why.

name: Friday Night in A&E
summary: Cameras follow the Emergency Care Team at Hull Royal Infirmary as the end of the working week collides with the weekend.

name: LBJ: Triumph and Tragedy
summary: LBJ: Triumph and Tragedy is a four-part CNN Original Series that offers a captivating look at one of the most consequential and enigmatic presidents in American history: Lyndon Baines Johnson. Thrust into the presidency under tragic circumstances, LBJ used the office and political mastery to pass the most significant civil rights legislation since Reconstruction. But while he was reshaping the social fabric of America, he was simultaneously escalating a war that would rip the country apart at the seams, subsequently overshadowing his domestic accomplishments. Weaving together dramatic first-hand accounts from the last surviving members of LBJ's inner circle, never-before-broadcast archival material, and LBJ's own voice from secretly recorded audiotapes, Emmy Award-winning director Pat Kondelis crafts an intimate portrait of a larger-than-life figure full of fascinating contradictions, who left behind a complicated and polarizing legacy.

name: Abraham Lincoln
summary: The HISTORY Channel's three-night documentary event Abraham Lincoln will be a definitive biography of the 16th president, the man who led the country during its bloodiest war and greatest crisis.

name: Hayaller ve Hayatlar
summary: Hayaller ve Hayatlar follows the lives of four women, each one with her own unique story.

name: About Last Night
summary: Ayesha and Stephen Curry, invites three celebrity couples to go head-to-head in relationship trivia and games, competing to see who knows their partner best. The final couple will have the chance to compete in a bonus round against the Currys as they compete for an additional donation of their choice.

previousepisode.name: Tig Notaro/Stephanie Allynne/Andre Iguadola/W. Kamau Bell

name: The Making of an Ordinary Woman
summary: A story of a woman born in 60s grew up in a Chinese herbal medicine store in southern Taiwan. Love, marriage, and seniority in human relationships around her collide together, leading to a different aspect of life.

name: Říkání o víle Amálce
summary: A cartoon about the forest fairy Amalka. In the first tale, Amalka merrily walked between the fir trees and blew on the flowers so that the pollen was transferred from flower to flower. But the wind picked her up and lifted her high above the ground. … In the second tale, Amalka walks through the glades and helps herbs and flowers to scatter the seeds wider. And the harmful nettle does not let Amalka go further and "stings" her. The little fairy began to cry, and her tears turned into an amazing stream ...

previousepisode.name: Jak odešla spát až do jara

name: Behawiorysta
summary: Gerard Edling is a persona non grata in Opole law enforcement. However, due to his ability to interpret body language flawlessly, he is unofficially asked to help catch a dangerous madman.

name: Teorias da Conspiração
summary: Maria Amado is an investigative journalist at the peak of her career when a series of political and financial scandals drive her to question her beliefs. An influential lawyer, who's on to her every move from a distance, operates in the dark to mislead what she unearths. Pedro Soares Teixeira moves about the offices of power as freely as he moves through the crime underworld.

name: Idiotas, Ponto
summary: Three self-centred friends with a tendency to over analyse and discuss the minutiae of daily life, struggle through the issues of adult life. Unfortunately, their distorted points of view and rash judgements always end up dragging them into a spiral of untold misunderstandings.

name: O Atentado
summary: Summer of 1937. The dictatorial regime reaches its peak. The continued repression leads to the creation of an exile camp in Cape Verde – Portuguese colony – where the main opposition leaders are kept. It is in this context that a portentous bomb attack against Salazar is launched. But a miscalculation frustrates the attack on the President of the Council. Who, wanted Salazar dead after all?

name: Terra Nova
summary: In the North Atlantic, the ‘Terra Nova' lugger is having a bad fishing season. Cod is scarce and the captain decides to sail to Greenland – a dangerous crossing for a sailing vessel with no engine. As the crew struggles with the storms and icy waters of the Atlantic, families left behind struggle to survive the adversities of Portugal's social and political life in the late 1930s.

name: Samee Chua Keun
summary: The moment she opened her eyes, she noticed her body without clothes on and there was a man sleeping on his stomach next to her. The whole world seemed to collapse in front of her. Chon Phansa, a beautiful woman who was drunk until she lost her mind for just one night had to become a single mother inevitably. She decided to raise her child alone never thought to demand anything from that "Overnight Husband" of hers. However, this is called fate when the man who is "the father of her child" becomes involved in her life once again.

name: Is Xianzun Whitewashed Today?
summary: Picture a man reading a novel based on the ancient Xianxia world, becomes trapped within its pages as one of its main characters. As Xian Zun, he is scrIpted to be captured by the revengeful Chu Yel. Dissatisfied with the story's bleak ending, he establishes new interactions with Chu Ye, often with humorous results.

name: Hollywood Decoded
summary: Is there a deeper, more esoteric meaning to the popular movies that we all love? Jay Dyer and Jay Weidner delve into the intricacies of the symbolism hidden in blockbuster films to reveal the secret messages hiding in plain sight. Lurking within these mysteries we uncover secrets to predictive programming, unlocking human potential, and reveal conspiracies made for the whole of humanity.

name: Fastest Finger First
summary:
Fastest Finger First offers contestants the one prize money can't buy – a guaranteed place on 'Who Wants to Be a Millionaire...?' and the opportunity to win a million pounds.

Five contestants play against each other to take it in turn to work their way up the question ladder.  The two players with the biggest score at the end of the round go head-to-head in a Fastest Finger First dual. At the end of each episode, whoever is in the seat when the Klaxon sounds has won a place to be fast tracked to sit in the Millionaire hot seat in front of Jeremy Clarkson by-passing the usual Fastest Fingers First round that opens the show.

name: Учёности плоды
summary: 1944 Literature professor Maria Schiller comes from Germany to the German-occupied village of Mikhailovskoye to the Pushkin Museum and conducts educational work among Wehrmacht soldiers and local peasants, telling them about the great Russian poet. Her actions cause disapproval of the German command. The front is getting closer, and soon an order comes from Berlin - to take out all historical values from Mikhailovsky.

name: Muster Dogs
summary: Spanning the red earth of the Top End to the green pastures of regional Victoria, it showcases five passionate graziers from across Australia, each of whom has been given a Kelpie puppy from the same litter to train up to be a muster dog. It is an action-packed yet intimate character journey through the lives of the graziers as they participate in a unique experiment; to transform a greenhorn pup into an efficient working member of a mustering team, all in 12 months!

name: Diver: Special Infiltration Team
summary: The spread of criminal organisations around the city is out of control - Kyoto police are forced to take action. A special task force has been set up and elite undercover operatives known as DIVER are sent to infiltrate the underworld and conduct dangerous undercover investigations. Inspector Kurosawa, a man with 100 faces and a talent for martial arts, is the most respected and feared agent on the team. But with his own hidden, brutal code of justice, Kurosawa may be just as bad as the criminals he hunts. When a new gang of scammers starts to make waves, exploiting large sums from city residents, team DIVER springs into action. Setting out to expose the deep criminal connections at play: the threads they follow lead deeper into the darkness than anyone expected in this fast moving and intense action drama.

name: Ciężarówką przez Stany
summary: Ten program to przewodnik po najciekawszych zakątkach Stanów Zjednoczonych, a za razem możliwość poznania pracy kierowcy ciężarówki od kuchni. Przemierzymy Amerykę Północną wzdłuż i wszerz. Głównym bohaterem i przewodnikiem po USA będzie Dawid Andres - pochodzący z Polski kierowca, który na co dzień pracuje w firmie transportowej. Dawid nie boi się wyzwań - to, oprócz jego brata, jedyna osoba na świecie, która pokonała Amazonkę na rowerze wodnym! Odwaga u truckera to bardzo przydatna cecha. W ostatnich rankingach właśnie ta profesja uplasowała się na ósmym miejscu wśród najbardziej niebezpiecznych zawodów w USA. Życie zawodowego kierowcy osiemnastokołowego pojazdu to nie bajka - Dawid Andres wie o tym doskonale, a mimo to nadal z wielką pasją przemierza tysiące kilometrów amerykańskich dróg i jest najlepszym dowodem na to jak polscy truckersi spełniają swój „American dream".

name: In Your Heart
summary: The series tells the story of the childhood sweethearts Cheng Yi and Ling Zi Ming and the vindictive friends Lu Xiang Lin and Yue Yu Zhi. The four boys had subtle emotions in their contact with each other.

name: Our Days
summary: Coming from rural Thailand, Mon moves to Bangkok to start university. On his first day in the big city, he meets Soh, a local musician, who shows him around. During a drunk night, Soh kisses Mon. Mon, confused, leaves. However, Mon quickly finds out Soh is also a freshman in his same faculty! Soh learns of Mon's love for basketball and decides to join the same team with him. In one of the matches, Mon gets injured and Soh starts taking care of him. Saint, Mon's high school teammate, confesses his love for him too. In the end, which team will Mon choose? Soh or Saint?

name: Unforgotten Night
summary:
Tired of his unrequited, futile love, Kim is in need of someone to embrace his body for just one night as it's the only night Kim has to know what he truly wants. By a chance occurrence, the night introduces Kim to a mafia by the name of Kamol who decides to pursue Kim all for himself not wanting him to belong to anyone else.

Kim, a 25 year old office worker, has long held unrequited feelings for his beloved senior, Day. In a genuine attempt to forget about Day and move on with his life, Kim decides to give into his inner lust and pursue a one night stand with a random stranger he meets at a bar. But little does Kim know that this stranger is bound to fall for him irreversibly, to the point of no return.

Meanwhile, Kamol, a 30 year old mafia, is a man with special needs in bed who actively switches partners as no one is able to satisfy his desires in its entirety. By a curious twist of fate, Kamol crosses paths with Kim at a bar one night and the two then decide to engage themselves in pure carnal pleasure thereby making Kamol realize that he's finally found the one who's able to perfectly fit his needs. At this point, Kamol decides to make Kim his own and starts pursuing him irrevocably.

name: Win the Future
summary: Having met with overwhelming success as a regional sales director at Jieke, a major multi-national company poised to claim a lion's share of the Chinese market, Zhou Rui is thrilled when he learns his business acumen has granted him a huge promotion. Transferring to the company's headquarters in Beijing, Zhou Rui is dazzled by the endless opportunities that await him. However, it doesn't take long for him to realize that this glittering new life of his comes at a cost. Deprived of the sales team he personally trained, Zhou Rui has only his most trusted aide, Fang Wei beside him. To make matters worse, Zhou Rui has recently been assigned an impossible task, with an equally impossible deadline. With pressure mounting from his boss, Zhou Rui's only hope of survival lies in landing a huge deal with one of the country's most prestigious banks. Working against the odds, Zhou Rui approaches the bank with a lucrative offer, only to discover that their biggest competitor, Huikang, has been working on a deal with the bank for more than a year. As if to add insult to injury, Zhou Rui soon learns that heading up the opposition's cutthroat team is none other than his first love, Luo Jia. Overwhelmed by impossible odds and distracted by Luo Jia's sudden return to his life, Zhou Rui must find a way to rise above the opposition, if he's ever going to succeed. Will he be able to achieve the impossible, or will this life in the fast lane prove to be too much?

name: The Broken Marriage Vow
summary: A seemingly perfect home gets shattered by broken trust and infidelity, bringing forth catastrophic effects into the lives of the couple, their son, and to everyone else involved. This is a story about a woman scorned.

name: Queen Charlotte: A Bridgerton Story
summary: Betrothed to the mysterious King of England against her will, Charlotte arrives in London only to realise she was not exactly what the royals were expecting. As she learns to navigate the palace, the 'ton, and her unpredictable husband, she grows into one of Europe's most unforgettable monarchs.

name: After the Verdict
summary: After The Verdict tells a story of four very different Australians who have just finished jury duty on a high-profile murder trial. As they return to normal life, they begin to question their verdict and take matters into their own hands, investigating the murder themselves as they juggle the pressures and impacts on their personal lives.

name: Operation: Special Warfare
summary: In order to defeat the latest in terrorist factions, a very elite unite is created of 14 of the most skilled young military personnel from around the country. The team is called "Blue Lightening Commandos" and are led by Captain Qin Guan, a no-nonsense, hard-ball leader with a much softer interior and good heart. Though he doesn't show it all the time, he cares very much about his team and wants them to become the best of the best. He trains them hard but with a focus on safety and learning to trust each other.

name: Kandi & The Gang
summary: Kandi & the Gang chronicles Kandi, Todd and OLG's dynamic staff as they face a much-needed change at the restaurant while juggling their career ambitions, larger-than-life personalities and personal lives. After being hit with a myriad of obstacles, Kandi and Todd step in with a plan to turn the tide. With tensions rising as family members don't perform up to standards, a little tough love and a lot of restructuring will shake things up with the staff, whether they're ready for it or not.

name: The Man's Voice
summary:
Baek Tae Hwa is the owner of the cat and the co-pilot of the airline. He has a good biography and a beautiful appearance that would make anyone fall in love with him. Due to his naturally sweet nature, Baek Tae Hwa often made women cry without meaning to. One day, the pet hotel where he used to leave his cat during the flight unexpectedly closes, so Tae Hwa entrusts his pet to Go Mi Rim.
Go Mi Rim has an ordinary origin and is optimistic by nature. She works part-time at a convenience store while looking for a full-time job. Go Mi Rim agrees to take care of a cat belonging to her one-sided love interest, but she begins to hear the cat's voice after she is struck by lightning, creating a plot for an interesting novel.

name: Takane no Hana-san
summary:
Hana is a businesswoman who works for a company that produces traditional sweets, looks like a Snow Queen and does not let down a young employee Tsuyoshi, scolding for every mistake. But in fact, Hana is in love with him to the point of unconsciousness, however, in the absence of romantic experience, she cannot really express her feelings. Will Tsuyoshi respond to her love?

Based on the manga of the same name.

name: De Kasteelmoord
summary: On January 31, 2012, the eccentric lord of the castle Stijn Saelens is killed with a shot in the back in the hall of his castle. The same day, his father-in-law Dr Gyselbrecht is arrested. Gyselbrecht and Saelens have been at odds for some time now. Stijn Saelens has concrete plans to move with his family to a commune in Australia and there are rumors that Stijn Saelens is abusing his eldest daughter. The doctor has a clear motive but firmly denies having anything to do with the murder of his son-in-law.

name: Grid
summary: In 1997, a certain ghostly entity saved humanity and then disappeared. 24 years later, she shows up again and helps a serial killer escape from justice. The police and special services are trying to catch the mysterious ghost.

name: Love in Your Taste
summary:
22-year-old student Hong Cho Yi is dating a guy from the last year, their relationship is like a roller coaster, temperamental and explosive Cho And bumps into a young man who is not ready for a serious relationship yet. One day a girl sees her boyfriend in a cafe with a classmate, unable to contain her jealousy, she makes a scandal and the couple finally quarreled.
Hong Cho is upset and angry, but not discouraged, she has a lot of friends and girlfriends, besides, quite unexpectedly, she meets a guy living next door - Yun Dan, despite his young age, he is calm and thoughtful, has a cool-headed balanced character. This young man loves coffee. When he met Cho Yi, bright as a firework, he became interested in her. He will be able to become completely different when he tries to open up and understand the charm of the sharp temper of his beloved girl.

name: Mairu no Bitch
summary:
Unpopular high school student Kinoshita Mayru believes that she is ugly, but thanks to the school king Kumada Tenyu quickly turns into a pretty girl.

Based on the manga of the same name by Sato Dzakuri.

name: Race: Bubba Wallace
summary: This docuseries follows Bubba Wallace, the only Black driver currently in NASCAR's Cup Series, as he uses his voice and talent to change the sport.

name: Miman Keisatsu: Midnight Runner
summary: Totally inexperienced, all they have to fall back on are their youth, passion, and the lessons they're learning in class--and yet the two are already getting dragged into a string of complex cases. But thanks to the help of classmates and full-fledged detectives, they begin to solve one crime after another. Polar opposites end up complementing each other's shortcomings as they combine action with deductive reasoning in this comical yet serious police drama so fast-paced, it'll leave you breathless.

name: MIU 404
summary: The No. 4 Mobile Investigation Unit was quickly pieced together as part of reform efforts to overhaul the police organization. There, a wild maverick of a cop, Ibuki, gets paired with a serenely composed partner, Shima. Their role is to be on call 24 hours to fill in gaps in police shifts by investigative Units 1 to 3, to be the first investigators on crime scene and to risk their lives for a perfect criminal apprehension rate. In an increasingly morally relativistic world, questions such as "What is real justice" are posed in thrillingly fast-paced and comical whodunit fare with each episode a complete story.

name: Taiyou wa Ugokanai: The Eclipse
summary: Takano Kazuhiko is an agent of Asia Net Communcations (AN Communications), a secret intelligence organization that operates under the disguise of a news distribution company. Following a massive explosion at the construction site of the upcoming International City Expo 2023, he concluded that it was no accident and, together with a new recruit, is being tasked to find out who is the mastermind behind the attack

name: Boku wa Doko kara
summary: Takeuchi Kaoru is a young man with a special ability. He can experience the thoughts of others, just by copying their writings. Kaoru lives with his mother with Alzheimer's disease. He wants to become a writer, but, due to his special ability, he has a hard time writing his own work. Taking care of his sick mother also doesn't help his writing. One day, his mother gets into an accident. Fujiwara Tomomi, who went to same school as Kaoru, appears in front of Kaoru. Tomomi is a young yakuza and he makes an offer to Kaoru. The deal is if Kaoru takes a university entrance exam for someone and that guy gets into a top university, then he will make a lot of money. But, Kaoru gets involved in something unexpected

name: DCU: Deep Crime Unit
summary: Niina Masayoshi is the leader of DCU. The group was newly created by the Japan Coast Guard and stands for Deep Crime Unit. Their mission is to find evidence and dead bodies hidden underwater, that are crucial to solving criminal cases. Niina Masayoshi never gives up investigating the truth.

name: Tabikurage Tantei Nikki
summary: Depicts a detective who takes on a request for what he is looking for while wandering in a camper.

name: Rasen no Meikyu: DNA Kagaku Sosa
summary: Jin Jinbo is a DNA expert. He works as an associate professor of genome analysis laboratory at a medical school. A murder case takes place in Tokyo. The murderer left an 'X' mark on the dead body. Detective Genji Ando is excluded from the murder investigation, because of a high probability that his wife was murdered by the same person. The investigation headquarters secretly reaches out to Jin Jinbo for help.

name: No Activity: Honjitsu mo Ijou Nashi
summary: An unconventional detective duo of Shingo Tokita, a veteran detective who is full of clutter and does not work at all, and Yu Shiina, a partner who follows Tokita for stimulus, is investigating a completely out-of-place international drug trading case. I will be dispatched. Misato Satomi and Akira Ohira, who give instructions to them from the radio room, suddenly developed into a terrifying situation, although they should have been just talking about small things. Around that time, the criminal duo lurking in the warehouse: Ichijo and Ichijo were at the mercy of Mari, who was supposed to be the victim of the kidnapping.

name: Fuujinshi
summary: Osagami Kakeru is a master who is tasked with the mission of sealing the blades of filth called Kegareyaiba born from the dark sides of people's hearts.

name: Dekke Furoba de Mattemasu
summary: Shin and Ryudai run a public bathhouse, Otori no Yu, located in a suburb. The bathhouse has been there for 150 years, since the Edo period. Due to poor finances, Shin and Ryudai struggle to maintain the bathhouse. While they work, they face various problems and happenings caused by their customers.

name: I Annoyed Millions of Cultivators
summary: I Annoyed Millions of Cultivators tells the story of a Jiangbei student who fought valiantly at the subway station and was blessed by the system. Fortunately, he hosts the system and travels to another world. In this different world full of cultivators, Jiangbei had turned from a trash in a small town to a child genius in everyone's eyes. Relying on the system, Jiangbei has started the road of improvement and become stronger just by playing System, and irritating people. After a series of chaos and poetry battles, Jiangbei gradually developed feelings for his relatives here.

name: The Ark
summary: The Ark takes place 100 years in the future when planetary colonization missions have begun as a necessity to help secure the survival of the human race. The first of these missions on a spacecraft known as Ark One encounters a catastrophic event causing massive destruction and loss of life. With more than a year left to go before reaching their target planet, a lack of life-sustaining supplies and loss of leadership, the remaining crew must become the best versions of themselves to stay on course and survive.

name: Saint X
summary: Saint X is a psychological drama, told in multiple timelines and perspectives, which explores and upends the girl-gone-missing genre. It's a show about how a young woman's mysterious death during an idyllic Caribbean vacation creates a traumatic ripple effect that eventually pulls her surviving sister into a dangerous pursuit of the truth.

name: Survival of the Thickest
summary: Black, plus-size and newly single, Mavis Beaumont unexpectedly finds herself having to rebuild her life after putting all her eggs in one man's basket, but she's determined to not only survive but thrive with the support of her chosen family, a positive attitude, and a cute v-neck with some lip gloss.

previousepisode.name: It's Survival of the Thickest, Bitch.

name: Efsane T
summary: A documentary series about Tofaş owners and culture from 7 regions of Turkey.

name: Earnin' It: The NFL's Forward Progress
summary: From the football field to the front office, each season of America's most popular sport features more women in prominent roles.

name: Im Netz der Camorra
summary: One day Nino Sorrentino appears at the winery, an old friend of the landowner Matteo DeCanin. But Nino is more than a companion from Matteo's childhood days. He is part of Matteo's dark past, which took its fateful course in Naples. At the same time, a bad incident shook the idyllic life in the area: At night, a young woman was hit by a car on a mountain pass. Carabinieri Adrin Erlacher immediately takes over the investigation. Department head Christina Melauer wants to put the case aside, but the evidence piles up for the Carabinieri - especially when he finds the wine label for a 3000 euro wine among the evidence. The honest law enforcement officer investigates on his own. Winemaker Matteo is also the focus of his investigations.

name: World's Most Toxic Animals
summary: Lurking in the oceans, to the forest, swamps and deserts, are a litany of lethal little killers. Here, explore what defines a poison from a toxin and which venoms pack the greatest punch.

name: The Cool Crystal Show
summary: "The Cool Crystal Show" is a solo magazine-style variety show written, directed, and produced by, and starring T'Keyah Crystal Keymáh.    In the half hour series, veteran performer T'Keyah Crystal Keymáh celebrates culture, and her personal heroes, does scenes from her stage shows, presents new characters and bits, and expresses her rather opinionated and often conspiracy-laced views on the world.  The show debuted on December 30, 2020 with new episodes being presented on Wednesday through March of 2021.  Segments include book reviews, art showcases, stand-up comedy, porch conversations, and a cooking show.

name: Cadde Cadde İstanbul
summary: This documentary traverses the streets of Istanbul, revealing the multicultural nature of the city and how it witnessed history.

name: Memory of Encaustic Tile
summary:
Inside the hutongs of Beijing, the children of the museum keepers live in the Forbidden City. They grew up, survived the SARS epidemic, the death of loved ones, the demolition of the old city, and struck up a deep friendship with each other. As they get older, everyone chooses different paths.
Shaoxue does not want to give up unlimited opportunities and leaves home in search of a bright future.
Zhang Su Nian follows in his mother's footsteps, becomes a restorer and finds meaning in preserving cultural heritage.
Zhang Qi gets the opportunity to study abroad thanks to his mathematical abilities. Before leaving, he decides to bury his feelings for Zhao Xue.
Despite their feelings for each other, Zhao Xue and Zhang Su Nian are at odds because of the differences in their fields of activity. After a long time, they meet again, allowing the seeds planted in youth to germinate again.
Based on the novel of the same name by Bai Feng Shan Bai Li.

name: Ciężarówką przez Wietnam
summary: This time Dawid Andres will take us on a journey through Vietnam. After driving along and across the United States, Dawid Andres will discover Vietnam for us. We will find out what it is like to work in a transport company in South Asia. David will travel kilometers of dangerous and difficult routes from Hanoi, through Haiphong, Saigon, to the Mekong Delta. Apart from the locals, apart from the Vietnamese police, in not always social circumstances. He will visit places more and less popular with tourists, such as the demilitarized zone, the U Minch National Park, a floating market or an abandoned water park. There will also be meetings with the local cuisine and culture, of which Dawid will certainly pass on to viewers.

name: Ciężarówką przez Route 66
summary: The most famous truck driver Dawid Andres sets off on another journey! This time on the legendary US road - Route 66! The legendary Route 66 was one of the most important roads connecting the western and eastern shores of the United States. In 1985 it was removed from the list of highways. Currently, it is a world-famous tourist attraction. Dawid Andres will cover almost 4,000 kilometers from Chicago to Los Angeles. What does this iconic road look like from his perspective? Together with David, viewers will travel through as many as 8 states. In each of them, many surprises await the host of the Discovery Channel. Driving a truck on this famous route will not be the easiest. The constant weight limitation or the inability to cross many bridges are only some of the difficulties. How will David's journey end? Will he find out where the phenomenon of one of the most famous routes in the world comes from?

name: Ciężarówką przez Afrykę
summary: Dawid Andres goes on another long journey. This time it's time for Africa! Surprising routes, unusual views, unpredictable difficulties and original local cuisine and culture await him there. How does it all look from the perspective of a hit truck driver?

name: Ciężarówką przez Indonezję
summary: With his eighteen-wheeled truck he has already traveled the length and breadth of the United States and Vietnam. It's time to go on another journey full of extraordinary adventures, interesting places and interesting meetings. This time, Dawid Andres will visit Indonesia. Beautiful views, dangerous mountainous routes, local culture - you will see this extraordinary country from the perspective of a Polish truck driver. Combining business with pleasure, i.e. work with traveling. Dawid invites you to a completely new, exciting journey. Where will his curiosity, his incredible openness and sense of humor lead him this time?

name: Baba
summary: It will be told that the life of Emin Saruhanlı, who has not been at odds with his brother Mehmet Ali for years, suddenly changed with the plane crash.

name: Juvenile Justice
summary: A strict judge examines complex cases in juvenile court, balancing between dislike for juvenile criminals and harsh views on justice and punishment.

name: The Decade the Rich Won
summary: The people with power in Britain reveal how their decisions shook our politics, transformed our economy and reshaped society in the decade following the 2008 financial crisis.

name: Tomorrow
summary: Choi Joon Woong, a young job seeker, who can't get a job and through an accidental accident, meets angels of death Goo Ryun who are on a special mission of suicide prevention, and works with them as the youngest contract worker in the crisis management team of death angels.

name: Somebody
summary: A software developer and her friends become entangled in a murder case involving her dating app and a mysterious man who seems to be hiding something.

name: Why Her?
summary: Oh Soo Jae is a talented lawyer and the youngest partner at TK Law Firm, the best law firm in South Korea. Oh Soo Jae is driven by her desire to win cases and also her self-righteous principles. She has lived her life to achieve success, but she gets involved in an unexpected case and she gets demoted to work as an adjunct professor at a law school. At the law school, Oh Soo Jae meets Gong Chan. He is a student there. Gong Chan has experienced a painful past, but he still has a warm heart. He falls in love with Oh Soo Jae and he would do anything for her. Meanwhile, Choi Tae Kook is the chairman of TK Law Firm. He would do anything to satisfy his desires, even if it's illegal or immoral.

name: The Golden Spoon
summary:
Adapted from the webtoon "The Golden Spoon" (금수저) by HD3.
An adventure of a boy who stumbles across a magical golden spoon that allows him to switch with the rich parents of another boy. Would you trade your poor but loving family for a life of riches? When Seung Cheon gets his hands on a magical spoon that allows him to switch lives with his rich best friend, he thinks it's a no-brainer. But life-altering decisions are always accompanied by a sense of doubt, and with only three chances to change his mind, Seung Cheon has to decide which of his two possible futures is worth keeping.

name: Bosch: Legacy
summary: Harry Bosch, retired homicide detective turned Private Investigator, fights to work cases without the authority his former job provided. Attorney Honey "Money" Chandler, having survived an attempted murder, struggles to maintain her faith in the justice system. And Maddie Bosch discovers the possibilities and challenges of being a rookie patrol cop on the streets of Los Angeles.

name: Cheer Up
summary: A mystery campus romance set in the backdrop of a cheering squad where eating and living is useless in the moment, but splendid and precious romance is.

name: Predators
summary:
We follow the stories of six apex predators at a critical moment in their lives as they attempt to secure the future for the next generation.  Grappling with multiple responsibilities these are deadly hunters, caring parents, and cunning survivors who hold secrets and thrilling stories in their quest to survive. 

For Polar Bears in Canada, Wild Dogs in Zimbabwe, Pumas in Chile, Lions in Botswana, Brown Bears in Russia, and Cheetahs in Tanzania, this is the ultimate power struggle. The stakes have never been higher - who will win and who will lose?

name: Extraordinary Portraits
summary: Where skills meet stories. Artists create breathtaking portraits of people with incredible personal and powerful stories - creating a picture of modern Britain.

name: The Nilsen Files
summary: Re-examining one of the biggest murder investigations in Metropolitan Police history. Did prejudice lead to multiple missed opportunities to catch serial killer Dennis Nilsen?

name: The Bizarre Pet Vets
summary: Dr James Haberfield and his team from the Unusual Pet Vets treat the most bizarre and beloved animals in Australia. With three clinics across the country, they see hundreds of species every week and many of them are home grown! For a bizarre pet vet, no two creatures are the same and the owners are a rare breed too. Dr James and his team use their expertise and some clever handiwork to save the weirdest and most wonderful pets in the country.

name: Demolition NZ
summary: Demolition teams across New Zealand work together to bring down the colossal, the difficult, and the dangerous. We take you behind the barriers and show you the problems that demolition teams face daily - and some more unusual conundrums as well. Our teams grapple with breakdowns, church collapses, floors falling, explosions, time capsules, vermin infestations, and even a few ghosts. Our cameras are in the diggers with the operators, catching the action from above, and on the ground as the buildings come down.

name: Hometown Saints
summary: Hometown Saints revolves around Billy Riedell, a retired hockey player who struggles to figure out who he is now that his career is over. He ends up back in his hockey-crazed Minnesota hometown, reluctantly coaching a girl's high school team.

name: The World of Lee Evans
summary: Manic physical comedian Lee Evans stars in a series of short comedy dramas that showcase the unique talents of this former boxer turned Perrier Award-winner and film star.

name: City of Streamer
summary: Set in the Shanghai Shores at the beginning of the 20th century, where warlords begin to seize their powers; many heroes emerge, and revolutionary movements begin to rise. Making use of their wealth, the influential Rong family often abused their powers to commit various heinous crimes. In order to uphold justice, Feng Shi Zhen decided to embark on the road of revenge. She successfully sneaked into the Rong family, and became a tutor of the young master Rong Jia Shang. However, in the midst of testing and making use of each other, Feng Shi Zhen slowly finds herself falling for the enemy's son. When the truth of the injustice and grievances that happened twenty years ago begin to surface, the two lovers who were initially in two different camps work together to brave through numerous hurdles, and ultimately reveal the shocking truth.

name: A Year-End Medley: Extended Version
summary: A story of the people that work at Hotel Emros around New Year's and the guest that stay there.

name: Dateline Unforgettable
summary: A series of reports chosen by "Dateline" correspondents that answers the question they most often get asked — what their most memorable story is and why.

name: Üç Kız Kardeş
summary: Once upon a time in a beautiful yet mysterious country, there lived three sisters named Türkan, Dönüş, and Derya. As a close-knit family, they would dream of a promising future every night. Perhaps such an upbringing, that was similar to a fairy tale on the pine-scented streets of Ayvalık, had not prepared them for the grim reality of adulthood. Over time, the sisters discover that life and the choices that are accompanied by it are not as easy as they seem. Inconceivable secrets can be hidden even by those who are trusted the most and horrific illnesses can lead to the resurrection of the past. This leads them to the question: Is there anything in the world that time cannot heal?

name: Devadesátky
summary: In several period cases, it shows the atmosphere of a time when crime jumped to unexpected heights and when it was decided whether the police would find and hold their role. In the "1990s", freedom for all brings a sharp increase in crime. The police have no method, time or resources to deal with it. It seems that big and small bastards will definitely have the upper hand. The young investigator Tomáš Kozák joins the Prague 1st Department. Experienced operative Václav Plíšek does not trust his new colleague. But they have to face an unprecedented supply of murders together.

name: Агеев
summary: Anton Ageev is an operative with one of the highest detection rates in the city, which is why the management turns a blind eye to his sharp, quarrelsome nature and unusual manner of work. And only Kira Kirillova, who appeared in the department 5 years ago, was able to find out the truth about the closed Ageev. But one day there is a murder, which Ageev and Kira witness. Watching the video of the moment of the murder, Ageev realizes that Kira is related to the case and is hiding something.

name: Seus Olhos
summary: Your Eyes is an LGBTQIA + series loosely inspired by real events and tells the story of the love relationship between Lia and Veronica. While Veronica is forced to deal with some traumas, Lia immerses herself in a process of elaborating and questioning her own gender identity.

name: Welcome to Chippendales
summary: A sprawling true-crime saga, Welcome to Chippendales tells the outrageous story of Somen "Steve" Banerjee, an Indian immigrant who became the unlikely founder of the world's greatest male-stripping empire - and let nothing stand in his way in the process. The series details the insane, darkly comedic, crime-ridden story behind the unique male revue that became a cultural phenomenon.

name: Khuda aur Mohabbat
summary: Farhad and Mahi hail from completely different economic and cultural backgrounds. Mahi, who comes from an influential family, must adhere to the conventions and requirements of her family's class despite her true jovial nature. Farhad on the other hand belongs to a small town and is instantly drawn to the charismatic Mahi and soon forsakes everything for her. Though Mahi appreciates Farhad's efforts, she does not have the same feelings for him. In the quest to win Mahi's heart, Farhad finds himself forming a special bond with his creator and becomes a devotee of love. In this classic love story, two star-crossed souls struggle to fight for their love. Will destiny bring them together? Will the boundaries of class and society be broken? Or is Farhad destined to live the life of a devotee?
